lines.english: Mouth and tongue, too, were said to be mucous membranes that delighted in sex. Certainly this deep kiss suggested sex more than a mere joining of lips. The stimulus was almost too strong for his exhausted body; his consciousness began to blur. Still her tongue sucked, stirred, licked within his mouth, and would not release him.

lines.japanese: 「ちゅっ、ちゅう……はむぅ……っ」
lines.english: “Mm… Mmm… Mmm…!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ……ん」
lines.english: “Haa… Mmm…”

lines.japanese:
どれだけ泪に舌を、口の中を翻弄されていたのか、ふっと朔屋が自我を取り戻したのは、泪の舌が何かを押しこんできたから。
　円く、ころころした舌触りで、泪が先ほど掬[すく]い上げた真珠を口伝えにしてきたのに、朔屋は些[いささ]か動揺した。普通に貰えればいいのに、なぜこんな、と訝しみ、掌に吐き戻そうとして、たちまちに意識が口内の感触に奪われる。不思議な感触だった。
lines.english:
How long had she toyed with his tongue, the inside of his mouth? What brought Sakuya back to himself was her tongue pressing something in. Round, rolling against his own tongue.
She had passed him one of the pearls she had scooped up. He was a little alarmed. Why this, when she could have handed it to him normally? Puzzled, he tried to spit it into his palm. At once, the sensation inside his mouth seized his awareness. A strange sensation.

lines.japanese:
何時までも口内の熱に温[ぬる]む事がなく、少し冷えて、味はないのに仄[ほの]かに香った。
　薄荷をつけたように爽やかに、蜜に浸したように甘やかに、香水のようにも香り、ほどよい苦みを帯びた柑橘類のようでもあり、舌を刺すようにきつい酸味、えぐみ、血の味、そんなものさえあり、朔屋が感じたのは、これは泪、なのではないかと。今の泪の存在を為す諸々が、真珠の中に香りとして封じ込められて、青年の口中に香っているのではないか、と。
lines.japaneseRuby:

lines.english:
It never warmed to his mouth's heat, but remained a little cool. Tasteless, yet faintly fragrant.
Fresh as mint, sweet as something dipped in honey, perfumed, like citrus with a pleasant bitterness. Sharp sourness that pricked the tongue, acridity, even the taste of blood. Sakuya wondered: was this Rui? Had all the things that made up her present existence been sealed within the pearl as fragrance, to bloom inside his mouth?

lines.japanese: 口内に漂う香りについ陶然と遠くした、青年の心の隙を突くように、
lines.english: As though seizing the opening left when that scent carried his heart dreamily away—

lines.japanese: （飲んで───飲むのよ）
lines.english: (Drink—Swallow it.)

lines.japanese:
泪は命じて、瞼をふっさりと下ろした、その動きが、まるで青年の中枢と連動したかのように、朔屋の舌に、喉に、勝手な嚥下の動きを呼んで、こくん、と躊躇う間もなく呑み込ませた真珠、喉の奥に滑り落ちていく。
　慌てて戻そうとするも遅かった。すとんと体の中、底の方に落ち着いてしまった。

lines.english:
Rui commanded, then softly lowered her eyelids. As though that motion were linked to the very center of his nervous system, his tongue and throat swallowed of their own accord. Before he could hesitate, the pearl slipped down his throat.
Hastily he tried to bring it back, too late. It dropped and settled deep within his body.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅぅ……ん。む……」
lines.english: “Hhh… Mmm… Hh…”

lines.japanese: 「……はぁぁ。美味しかったわ。直さん」
lines.english: “…Haa… Delicious, Nao.”

lines.japanese: 長い口づけの後、泪は満足の吐息で朔屋に微笑んだが、求めていた真珠を呑み込まされてしまった朔屋は困惑しきりで。もう一つ別のを下さいと、言い出す事もできずに、泪に送られて彼女の船室を後にするしか無く。
lines.english: After that long kiss, Rui smiled at him with a satisfied sigh. Sakuya, made to swallow the pearl he had come seeking, was thoroughly bewildered. Unable even to ask for another, he could only let her see him out of the cabin.
